pages.title: Two Sweet Reins
pages.text: Two correctly attached hooks turn the worm into transport.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Gobthumper made from Gumball Piles attracts the worm. Hold one hook in each hand, embed both and steer the ride; Sweet Tooth for the sack comes from its defeat.
